compatibility_with_r2_11_new_workloads: The repair function is unconditional and content-agnostic -- it operates purely on graph-id/layer-count structure in by_graph, not on workload identity, prompt content, or category. It is therefore automatically compatible with the 12 new R2-11 workloads without any change, and will apply identically if any future R2-11 capture happens to trigger the same 512-token-prefill split-tail condition. Required in acquisition_plan.json's capture_failure_rules: every future R2-11 capture must also pass the EXPLICIT trace_completeness() check, not rely on normalize()/reconcile() alone (instruction #20 and R2-BRIDGE-01's own prior lesson that reconcile() alone is not a substitute).
r2_bridge01_confirmation: Confirmed BRIDGE_POSITIVE evaluation (commit 58b36a1) already validated this repair end-to-end on real captured traces across 4 workloads with zero scoring-path issues; R2-11 inherits that validation and the identical repair code, unmodified.
regression_tests: 11 regression tests added in the Phase-2A.1 turn (tests/test_r2_bridge01_phase2a1_instrumentation_repair.py), covering: match detection, non-match/no-op cases, the KeyError fix for mid-loop deletion, and end-to-end trace_completeness() recovery. All passing as of this R2-11 Phase-0 freeze (re-run, see Tests section).
root_cause: llama.cpp revisits the layer axis a second time within one logical forward pass when a prompt's prefill length exactly matches --ubatch-size (512 tokens); the C++ research instrumentation's 'layer went backwards => new forward pass' heuristic (patches/argine-experts.cpp:836-842) then files the trailing sub-batch under a NEW graph id, including the single real top-layer R-record. _absorb_split_tail_graphs() detects and reabsorbs exactly this pattern.
scope: Attribution-only: reassigns which graph id a layer-47-equivalent (globally-highest-layer) R-record belongs to, and deletes the now-empty phantom graph id. Runs inside Trace construction (rawlog.py:to_trace()), strictly upstream of any retention-policy decision logic.
why_it_does_not_alter_routing_or_model_s: No expert-routing field (route ids, n_tok, n_used) of any R record is altered; only graph-id bookkeeping is changed. No retention policy code path reads graph ids directly -- PredictedProtectPolicy and B_selected operate on Trace.token_selections()/Step objects, which are constructed AFTER the repair runs.
